Method of Attack: Injecting DLL into legitimate Windows wermgr.exe executable from memory using 'MemoryModule' project code
DLL injection using Doppel Hollowing (process doppelganging) to evade detection
Downloading modules to perform tasks such as stealing Active Directory Services database, lateral network spreading, screenlocking, stealing cookies and browser passwords, stealing OpenSSH keys
Giving access to Ryuk and Conti ransomware threat actors
Indicators of Compromise: Use of MemoryModule DLL loading from memory
Use of NTFS transactions for rollback to hide payload
